approach_summary: Investigate and fix the failing test `test_safe_fix` in the CI pipeline by reviewing the test code, identifying any bugs or incorrect assertions, ensuring proper test setup/teardown, and validating against expected outcomes. This may involve debugging the test itself or fixing underlying issues in the production code that cause the test to fail.
risk_assessment: Changes to `some_module.py` could inadvertently introduce bugs if not thoroughly tested. CI pipeline configuration changes may affect other tests if not properly isolated.
